taxonomy: Dual-mode data table primitive supporting: 1. Atomic compound composition (<Table>, <Table.Header>, <Table.Body>, <Table.Row>, <Table.Head>, <Table.Cell>, <Table.Footer>, <Table.Caption>). 2. Declarative data-driven mode (<Table columns={...} data={...} keyExtractor={...} responsive="stack" />) with automatic container-query card stacking (@container).
Implements explicit column header semantics (scope="col"), 56px minimum row heights for OS text zoom adaptability, and automatic tabular-nums on numeric columns.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: semantic tokens, concentric geometry, and motion restraint.
